title: Adult Fecundity Assessment in Drosophila
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rq2d5ye
materials: Briefly, 47 female flies of each genotype and diet, ranging from 3-5 days old were randomly transferred into separate 6 mL glass vials (Sigma-Aldrich) and allowed to oviposit for 24 hours.

steps.title: Transfer flies to experimental diet
steps.instruction: Move adult flies from instant food to each experimental diet and keep them for one full generation before measuring fecundity.

steps.title: Count eggs per vial
steps.instruction: Under a microscope, count the number of eggs in each vial.
